acceptance: Only APG validation documentation and a machine-readable result summary are added to the GitHub repository.
Local tests and governance checks pass before commit and push.
A single commit is created on the confirmed main branch and push succeeds to the confirmed remote.
Remote commit SHA, changed paths, and post-push status are recorded as evidence.
Rollback is documented as reverting the single commit; no release/tag is created unless separately authorized.
inputs.metric: APG validation evidence is published reproducibly without changing product implementation or executing deployment/release actions.
non_goals: Do not publish or implement the child-learning product.
Do not add credentials, real data, provider integrations, runtime, deployment, pilot, or unrelated local fixture files.
inputs.outcome: Publish only the APG validation result and bounded evidence summary to the confirmed GitHub repository main branch, then retain remote commit evidence locally.
inputs.problem: The APG project validation result is complete and the target GitHub repository is reachable, but the validation result has not been published to the APG repository.
inputs.rollback: Revert the single evidence-only commit on main after verifying the exact commit SHA; preserve all local APG receipts and source evidence.
inputs.rollout: Run local tests and scans, update only the APG repository validation evidence files, commit once, push to main, and record the remote result.
